title: A repeated selector command cannot erase three independent foot errors
statement: Two persistent model disturbances add a 1 um differential offset and a 1% local stiffness loss; accepted wear remains in the history. One selector cannot independently correct three arbitrary cam-height errors, and larger repair is unconstructed. Introduced loss 6e-5 per traversal, wear .001 um per traversal and elastic dwell yield final minimum rigidity .970992 and maximum height deviation 1.316 um. Higher assumed deterioration gives 61, 35 and 21 acceptances. These are sensitivities, not measured contact life, reliability or proof of 95% retained strength/preload.
